title: spec(changes): delete the committed spec-changes per-major projection and the upgrade guide copy, with their two merge=os-regen routes, once generation at publish has landed (#22449 B′)
body:
Filing gate: **③ a maintainer-directed task.** Ruling `6078203801` on #22449 (B′). Filed by `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-tesla` · session `session_01VZqqwTj2wsihZEbfT6yyYN`, as the ruling's card ③ and triage `6078734415` item 3. Parent: #22449. ⛔ Not a claim.

Blocked-by: #22482
Blocked-by: #22483

## What the ruling sets

"The committed copies and their two `merge=os-regen` routes are deleted; `check:spec-changes` and `check:upgrade-guide` stop comparing a committed copy."
Triage `6078734415`: "⛔ Card 3 (the deletion) goes last. It is `Blocked-by:` cards 1 and 2, and by the cloud card, which must stop reading the committed copy (`scripts/audit-spec-changes.mjs:92`–`:93`) before the copy goes." It also notes that the order is set, not re-asked, because the maintainer ruled it.

## This card

- Delete the committed per-major projection in `packages/spec/spec-changes.json` and the guide body at `docs/protocol-upgrade-guide.md`, which card ② has already turned into a pointer stub.
- Delete their two routes in `.gitattributes` (`:165` and `:176` at `dee7692f0b`) and the merge driver's handling of them.
- Re-measure every reader of the committed copy and name each one in the PR. In this repo: `packages/spec/package.json`'s `files[]`, `packages/spec/scripts/check-generated.ts`, and `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh` with the pm-dispatch hot-file serial queue that cites it. In cloud: the audit card.
- ⛔ Not before card ① ships the projection inside the tarball through the publish lane: a consumer reading `node_modules` must never see a missing file.

## Also waiting on

The cloud seat's audit card (condition 3: cloud's changed-spec-surface guard reads a projection generated in the check, not the committed copy). Its `Blocked-by:` line goes here when it is filed.
